review.tagline: Desktop app for switching API providers across AI coding CLIs
review.summary: CC Switch is a Tauri 2 desktop app (Rust) for Windows, macOS and Linux. It swaps API providers for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Pi and MiniMax Code, and manages MCP, Skills and Prompts in one place, so JSON, TOML or YAML configs need not be edited by hand.
review.audience: Developers juggling API providers across several AI coding CLIs
strengths: Covers ten coding agents and CLIs from one provider list
Manages MCP servers, Skills and Prompts alongside provider switching
Native desktop builds for Windows, macOS and Linux via Tauri 2
MIT licensed, with a user manual and multilingual READMEs
weaknesses: Desktop GUI only; no Docker image or server mode
Much of the README is sponsor relay advertising, not technical detail
Config backup and rollback behavior unknown; README is truncated
Does not run agents itself; the CLIs must be installed separately
needs: Models: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build
